composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the rack centered and spanning about 80% of the frame width with even margins (at least 10% on every side). The rack is WIDE and SHALLOW — a long low object, roughly three times wider than it is deep — so its four grooves are seen clearly from above-front and run horizontally across the full width of the rack. The rack is completely EMPTY. No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the rack floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadow only inside the grooves. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: attribute marks, icons, badges, symbols, labels, scale marks or tick marks
balls, beads, counters, markers or anything resting in the grooves
a chart, graph, bar meter, progress bar or any diagram-like flat graphic
wires, rods or strings across the frame
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the rack
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the rack.
purpose: こんだてPLAY の状態 cue。4 本の溝に粒が転がって集まり、溝の中央のくぼみに収まると「ちょうどいい」が体で分かる物理的な道具。図表ではなく、机の上に置かれた木の道具として読めること
scene: a wide, shallow counting rack made of warm beige clay-wood, like a simple abacus frame or a wooden tray of grooves, standing on a low rim so it reads as a real physical object resting on a table. FOUR parallel horizontal grooves are carved into its top surface, evenly spaced one above the other, each groove running the full width of the rack; every groove is a smooth shallow channel that a small ball could roll along. In the MIDDLE of each of the four grooves the channel is carved noticeably DEEPER and slightly WIDER — a clearly visible resting hollow at the centre of every groove, obviously deeper than the shallower ends of the same groove. The rack is EMPTY: nothing rests in the grooves. Warm beige and cream matte clay-wood, soft rounded edges, handmade toy feeling. Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set and the cream lunch tray.
required_objects: one wide shallow wooden clay rack seen from above-front
exactly four parallel horizontal grooves running the full width, evenly spaced
a visibly deeper and slightly wider resting hollow at the centre of each of the four grooves
completely empty grooves with no balls or markers
